title: A column of a table variable is referenced with the name of its base table
query: EVALUATE ROW ( "r", VAR Expensive = FILTER ( Product, Product[Price] >= 50 ) RETURN SUMX ( Expensive, Product[Price] ) )

source.quote: In order to reference a column inside a variable, you need to reference the column name with the base table prefix.
source.supports: Product[Price] is how the Price column of the variable is referenced

derivation: Prices: Bike 100, Helmet 20, Lock 10, Scooter 50. Expensive holds Bike and Scooter; the sum of Product[Price] over it is 100 + 50 = 150, a fixed decimal.
